gitCommit.subject: Sort flow: one-tap start, person-side hub, set-aside on the Decide side (#356)
gitCommit.body:
Sort flow: one-tap start, person-side hub, set-aside on the Decide side (#356)

* Sort flow polish: design spec

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Sort flow spec rev 2: fold review (authz-first redirect, e2e blast radius, null goal, honest secondary label, permanentRedirect)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(sort): one-tap start with remembered defaults; hub speaks person-side

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(sort): set-aside shelf lives on the Decide side; old path redirects

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sort): one island on first run; one-tap survives a dropped connection

- At zero sessions, header slot condition now checks sessions.length > 0, rendering only the empty state's island
- StartSortingButton wraps fetch in try/catch, showing error message and re-enabling on rejection (offline scenarios)
- Added test assertion for exactly one button at zero sessions
- Added rejection-path test for fetch failure handling

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Session-tier collapse: proposal for owner review (purses-znkt.3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(sort): the deliberate path survives the empty state

- Empty state now renders both the one-tap island and the quiet 'Set a goal first' secondary link
- Ensures the deliberate form path remains reachable after set-aside (soft-delete) scenarios
- Updated test assertion to verify both button and link presence in empty state

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* graphify: refresh committed graph

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
